title: Connect your agent
help_created: These snippets contain the real key. Copy what your client needs now: after you leave this page they show gp_… instead of the key.
help_list: The secret was shown once, when the key was created. Replace gp_… with the saved key that starts with %s.
claude_code_help: Run this in a terminal on the computer where you use Claude Code.
desktop: Claude Desktop or any stdio client
desktop_help: For clients that start a local process (claude_desktop_config.json). It must run on the server that holds the site: set command to the gorun binary, GORUN_DATA to the data directory and GORUN_THEMES to the themes directory. The paths shown are examples.
http_help: For Cursor and other clients that connect to a remote MCP server: add this to their MCP JSON configuration.
test_help: Runs MCP initialize and tools/list as this key inside the site. No tool is called.
api_kind_note: This is a REST API key: it works on /mcp and on the REST API. For an AI agent, an AI agent key (MCP only) is safer.
ok_tools: Tools this key can see: %d, in %d toolsets:
hint_not_found: This key does not exist (it may have been deleted). Create a new key.
hint_revoked: This key was revoked. Create a new key, or rotate one that is still active, and update your client.
hint_expired: This key has expired. Create a new key with a later expiry date and update your client.
hint_owner_inactive: The key's owner is disabled or no longer exists, so the key is refused. Reactivate the user or create a key as an active user.
hint_onboarding: The key's owner has not finished first-login setup. Sign in as that user once and finish it.
hint_unauthorized: The secret does not match this key. Copy the key again from this panel.
hint_rate_limited: The key reached its rate limit. Wait a minute and test again, or create a key with a higher limit.
hint_no_tools: The key is accepted but its scopes reach no tools. Create a key with the scopes your agent needs (for example content.view); the owner's role limits them too.
hint_unavailable: The MCP server is turned off on this site. Turn on the MCP module under System → Modules, then test again.
hint_internal: The test could not run. The server log has the details ("admin: key test").
